entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There he is! That's Ushiwata! Let's get him!

entries.speaker: 明智 吾郎
entries.en: Hisashi Morozumi... Formerly known as[n]Hisashi Ushiwata.

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: What? What do you kids want?

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: Could it be... you're plotting against me[n]too!? I won't fall for it, you brats!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We are "too"...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you mean by that?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Crow...?

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: Would you just shut up!? Brats like you[n]should just do as you're told!

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: Using my power to make people bow to[n]me... It was so immature of me.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Not just immature. You framed your own[n]child...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let Toji go now. Turning your own son into a[n]criminal is sick...

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: My son... But he...

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: No, never mind...

entries.speaker: Hisashi Ushiwata
entries.en: I was in the wrong. And I must pay for my[n]crimes...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is this... a key?

entries.speaker: 明智 吾郎
entries.en: May I have that key?
All right.
What will you do with it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Something came to mind, that's all.[n]I don't intend to do anything bad with it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: To make up for it, please take this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You can have it as thanks for accepting[n]my request.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! Now they'll release Toji, right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't sense a presence anymore, so the[n]change of heart should have worked.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I'll let you all know what becomes[n]of Karataki. No matter what happens.
